title: Tailwind v4 configuration: Use CSS-first @import and @tailwindcss/postcss, rather than legacy v3-only entrypoints.
description: UI Systems Track 08 tutorial for tailwind v4 configuration with a red starter, instructor implementation, local regression tests and honest browser/interaction boundaries.
